title: bet.voided
description: Every leg of a bet was void at its first settlement (C10 §6): the net stake is refunded by BET_VOID, or by BET_VOID_TAXED when D9's win tax applies to the refund. Published by the settlement module on NATS subject evt.bet.voided (version 1). Consumers: C13; C19 for retail tickets (B9). A voided bet doesn't count towards bonus wagering (C11). This is the `data` payload; the envelope (event_id, type, version, tenant_id, occurred_at, trace_id) is TD-02 §5. Every amount is in santim and every number is the bet's own (slipcalc's quote of its legs' results under its rules version). Ids only, no personal data. New fields are additive only.

rules_version.description: The tenant config version whose rules priced and settle the bet (C16 §6)

stake_santim.description: The stake charged (D1.3: a remainder isn't)

settlement_version.description: A bet's first settlement; later ones publish bet.resettled

payout_santim.description: Paid to the player in all: the quote's net payout, accumulator bonus and stake-tax refund included (0 for a loss)

acca_bonus_santim.description: Paid by its own ACCA_BONUS from HOUSE_BONUS_COST (C11)
